W1-000.canonicalOwner: CH-04 Realtime Substrate, Devices & Shared Presentation (charteredBy RC-C6). Executed as PRE-ENTRY evidence: it discharges CH-04's owed boundary conditions without entering the chapter.

canonicalUnitIds.note: PBCR conditions 7 (targeted regression for the protected subsystem) and 8 (shared-system health report) are DOCTRINE conditions carried in PORTFOLIO_GOVERNANCE_DOCTRINE.md, not separately numbered chartered obligations. F112 (Meetings equivalent validation, OPEN) is the finding whose evidence this unit produces. No obligation is claimed closed by this unit.

W1-000.whyExecutableNow: Founder Ruling 2 states that where work reaches a protected boundary, execution STOPS at that boundary and applies the protected-boundary/PBCR governance before proceeding. Conditions 7 and 8 are owed for a crossing that ALREADY HAPPENED (the historical PB-02 / RC-C6 repair). Discharging them requires running existing suites and writing a report - it constructs nothing, mutates nothing, and crosses nothing. It is the only unit in the portfolio that makes a later protected crossing admissible without performing one.

No chapter is executing, so attribution is clean by construction - this is why the unit is FIRST

W1-000.productionDataImplications: NONE. Local suites over local fixtures. No production read, no production write.

Stage 5 independently records the enumerated consumer audit as safe, non-mutating work that can begin immediately, and its parallel-work note already places it in W1 while the chapter stays in W2.
